trace.question: When was the first time did Kevin Constant have his highest crossing score? Give the date.
trace.evidence: Kevin Constant refers to player_name = 'Kevin Constant'; highest crossing score refers to MAX(crossing)

attempts.sql:
SELECT pa.date
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND pa.crossing = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing)
    FROM Player_Attributes pa2
    JOIN Player p2 ON pa2.player_api_id = p2.player_api_id
    WHERE p2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  )
ORDER BY pa.date ASC
LIMIT 1

trace.final_sql:
SELECT pa.date
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND pa.crossing = (

    FROM Player_Attributes pa2
    JOIN Player p2 ON pa2.player_api_id = p2.player_api_id
    WHERE p2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  )
ORDER BY pa.date ASC
LIMIT 1
trace.answer: Kevin Constant's highest crossing score first occurred on February 15, 2013.
